verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven SaaS, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question, but nothing in the pack describes an API explorer, try-it console, or runnable examples. Probes for public OpenAPI/Swagger specs at standard paths all returned 404. The llms.txt, markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are different capabilities and are not credited here. Missing for 10: any evidence of an interactive API reference, runnable or try-it examples, or a published OpenAPI spec.
